review.notes: incremental re-review of 144 changed lines since c30b6b2. All 5 previous findings repaired (3.2 stated in Suggested.lean and named in README; Poincare-disk Check now a triangle; l stated in the Layer 2 Checks; 'L5 states no index value' deleted; Laplacian and DG 12.3/12.5 contract items removed). Two new P3 findings: R01, the gate fails statement-hygiene=4 on four haveI in the new 3.2 signature, which came from the previous review's suggested code; the repair is an instance binder [forall x, Fact (finrank (TangentSpace I x) = 2)]. A copy with it elaborates (8 sorry warnings only), the gate on a scratch clone gives statement-hygiene=0, and it is proved equivalent to the head statement in both directions. R02, the README 3.2 statement sentence and the docstring omit the integrability hypothesis hk, which is load-bearing (an x^3 sin(1/x) corner wiggle on the half-disk gives pi != 2pi without it). Gate: worker's gate fails only on R01; my rerun shows the same plus the known bare-rerun false positives (default order, family index); order-aware depcheck: 239 roadmaps, 2327 edges, 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with 8 sorry warnings only; #check audit of all 9 declarations shows no lost binder; the one-tactic probe does not close 3.2. Adversarial table: 15 new rows with computed values for 3.2 (disk, clockwise, square, L-shape, hemisphere, hyperbolic triangle, cusp, dimension, hk), conventions, and the changed 2.1/2.2/4.1 Checks; 16 rows carried from the previous review. 11 pinned declarations opened (orientationAt, fact_finrank_tangentSpace, card_eq, rightAngleRotation = I*z, oangle = arg(conj w * z), volume_carrier). Citations resolved: DG 12.2/12.4 on main, PositiveMass S3 at #956 head. Sample: locators in changed passages (do Carmo 4-5, Lee pp. 271-275, Chavel III) unchanged and still not legally readable; content verified by computation.
